description: WP-M4a wargear on the table (list build). Fixture sm11e_m4a_wargear (P1 Command phase): a Captain with a Relic Shield (6 W), a Terminator Assault Squad with two Storm Shields (two 4 W bearers), Vanguard Veterans with Combat Shields (5+ invulnerable save), a Land Raider with no roster wargear (it fires its printed default kit only). The allocation groups / invulnerable saves are read live and the Storm Shield wound chips are hovered for the screenshot.

steps.comment: decline any other open window (not under test)
decline any other open window (not under test)
Relic Shield: the Captain has 6 W (5 +1)

steps.script:
var groups: Array = Allocation.build_groups(GameState.get_unit("U_TERMINATOR_ASSAULT_SQUAD_A"))
var out := []
for g in groups:
	out.append("%d:%d" % [int(g.w), g.model_indices.size()])
out.sort()
print("[sm11e-m4a] terminator assault allocation groups ", out)
return out
steps.comment: Storm Shield: two 4 W models, three 3 W models (two allocation groups)
Combat Shield: every Vanguard Veteran has a 5+ invulnerable save

steps.script:
var names := []
for mid in RulesEngine.get_unit_weapons("U_LAND_RAIDER_A", GameState.state):
	for wid in RulesEngine.get_unit_weapons("U_LAND_RAIDER_A", GameState.state)[mid]:
		names.append(str(wid))
names.sort()
print("[sm11e-m4a] land raider weapons ", names)
return "multi_melta_ranged" in names or "hunter_killer_missile_ranged" in names
steps.comment: default kit: the Land Raider fires its printed loadout, not every option

steps.script:
var m = tree.root.get_node("Main")
var focus := Vector2(880.0, 1840.0)
var z := 1.4
var vp: Vector2 = m.get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
m.camera.position = focus
m.camera.zoom = Vector2(z, z)
m.view_zoom = z
m.view_offset = focus - vp / (2.0 * z)
return true
